factor_dict.CNE5_Beta: ac = d['close']*d['adj_factor']; ret = ac/ac.shift(1)-1; mkt = get_stock_index('000001','close').pct_change(); out = rolling_regbeta(ret, mkt, 252)
factor_dict.CNE5_ResidualVol: ac = d['close']*d['adj_factor']; ret = ac/ac.shift(1)-1; out = ret.rolling(252).std()*np.sqrt(252)
factor_dict.CNE5_EarningsYield: ep = 1/d['市盈率TTM']; cfp = d['每股经营现金流净额']/d['close']; out = 0.79*ep + 0.21*cfp
factor_dict.CNE5_Growth: out = row_rank(d['营业总收入同比-%']) + row_rank(d['归母净利润同比-%'])
